emotion_styles.sadness: quiet composition, restrained motion, reflective atmosphere, soft diffused light

character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist throughout this theme's entire music video: long dark hair fading to rose-gold at the ends, amber-gold eyes, with a distinct recognizable face and consistent adult proportions. They are a mirage dancer who guides lost travelers toward an oasis. Signature outfit: a flowing saffron and rose veil ensemble with a fitted travel bodice and gold anklets. Unique personal keepsake or tool: a glass vial holding a single drop of oasis water. Preserve the exact facial features, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, body proportions, outfit silhouette, and defining item in every scene.
consistency_rules: Keep this theme's named visual identity as one fixed protagonist across every scene.
Preserve the exact face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Maintain the signature costume, distinctive accessories, and defining personal item without random redesign.
Do not replace the lead or add another protagonist unless the lyrics explicitly require it.

visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with amber gold, burnt orange, turquoise; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by wide establishing shot with layered depth, slow cinematic dolly-in with stable horizon, gentle lateral tracking shot revealing environmental detail; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
